label: PF Backlog 550
title: restamp: re-stamp stale analyses with the current architecture fingerprint (CLI/API)
body:
## Why
Re-analysis after an architecture change was only reachable via core.grooming.refresh_stale (no CLI/API), and the
name 'refresh-stale' was unclear. Expose it as a first-class, plainly-named command.

## What
- /pf backlog restamp [--limit N] [--ai]: re-analyze OPEN items whose analysis is stale vs the current
  architecture and record the new arch_fingerprint; keeps authored context. Deterministic by default.
- API: POST /backlog/restamp (alias /refresh-stale retained).
- Semantics: restamp applies to items already COMPLETE-but-fingerprint-stale (re-stamps to COMPLETE); groom only
  PROPOSES (IN_PROGRESS) and needs an approve decision.

## Where
- core/grooming.py refresh_stale (unchanged); scripts/pf.py; api/routers/backlog.py.

## Verify
- Applied to product_forge: 33 items restamped; scope groomed 32/need_reanalysis 0; BI-PF-0390 groomed 11/ready 2.
- Gates: compileall, api_contract_check, pf_surface_check, ruff clean.
